scripts.lint: npm run lint:markdown && npm run lint:yaml && npm run lint:prettier
scripts.build: bash scripts/run.sh bundle exec jekyll build --source docs --destination docs/_site
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test:frontmatter && npm run build && npm run test:html && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:scripts: bash scripts/run.sh python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && bash scripts/run.sh bundle exec ruby tests/test_html.rb
scripts.test:frontmatter: bash scripts/run.sh bundle exec ruby scripts/validate_front_matter.rb
scripts.test:html: bash scripts/run.sh bundle exec ruby scripts/test_html.rb
scripts.content:update: bash scripts/generate_tag_pages.sh && bash scripts/run.sh python3 scripts/autolink_posts.py && bash scripts/run.sh python3 scripts/generate_thumbnails.py && bash scripts/run.sh python3 scripts/sync_gallery_yml.py && bash scripts/run.sh python3 scripts/update_stats.py && prettier --write 'docs/_posts/*.md' docs/_data/gallery.yml docs/index.md 'docs/tags/*.md' scripts/keywords.yml
scripts.run-local: bash scripts/run.sh bundle exec jekyll serve --source docs --destination docs/_site --livereload
